facts.text: John is mentoring younger players on his team, which he finds rewarding and enjoyable.

evidence.quote: I'm now mentoring the younger players on my team. It's super rewarding and I'm loving sharing my skills and knowledge with them.
It's been awesome gaining experience and adapting, motivating and encouraging everyone.

facts.text: John mentions that some of the younger players see him as a mentor, which he finds rewarding.

evidence.quote: Some of them do see me as a mentor, which is really rewarding.
It's been great to watch each of them develop and reach their goals - such a reward!

facts.text: John expresses fulfillment in seeing the younger players' growth, improvement, and confidence.

evidence.quote: Mentoring them has been awesome! Seeing their growth, improvement, and confidence is so fulfilling.
It's been great to watch each of them develop and reach their goals - such a reward!

facts.text: John shared a photograph of himself with some of the younger players at a recent practice.

evidence.quote: Here's a pic of me and some of the younger players at a recent practice.
